package.name: nav2_collision_monitor
package.description: Overlay for the nav2_collision_monitor package: the same executable, component, launch file and params file names, with the Lean-backed node of ROSlean as the collision monitor. Not the upstream package. It provides stop and slowdown zones on one laser scan only and refuses any other configuration, Nav2's default (an approach zone) included. The collision detector forwards to upstream's when it is installed underneath. No library and no headers are exported.
